items.question: By what count and in what locus are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are specified as a locus.
Beings are described as being in a tormented state.
The count and locus together fix the scope of that torment.
items.inference: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
uncertainties: Whether the count is literal or figurative remains unclear.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
